Landed: Gerrit 1938 merged as 8093c94e15. Concern boundary: tracker provisioning vs tickets-branch convergence — the ensure units' sole caller is _store/ensures._registry(), which lazy-imports and dispatches by id; ensures.py's own docstring already recorded that the units lived in init only because they owned the .gitignore/.gitattributes templates, so the templates moved with them.

ORCHESTRATOR VERIFICATION against the merged tree at origin/main, each AC re-run rather than accepted from the implementer's report:
  init.py 610 LOC (AC threshold <= 650); _init_ensures.py 237 (AC floor >= 100)
  _init_ensures.py defines _GITIGNORE, _GITATTRIBUTES and _gc_config_unit (3/3 present)
  _store/ensures.py references _init_ensures — the single dispatch site resolves
  tests/: exactly one entry in the commit, status A (ADDED) — tests/unit/test_init_ensures_seam.py; NO existing test modified
  .github/module-size-limit.txt unchanged between 8093c94e15^ and 8093c94e15
  scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check on the merged tree: active=49 new=0 increased=0 stale=0
  commit message names the ensure-registry seam and the concern

Deliberately kept in place by the implementer: _untrack_runtime_markers_unit + _UNTRACK_BATCH — not a content converger, and test_ensures_untrack_markers.py:155 patches _UNTRACK_BATCH as an init module attribute, so moving it would have left that patch silently inert while still passing.
